svg: Adopt in order of what you can’t retrofitOrder by the gap between cost now and cost later — not by cost now.CHEAP NOW · IMPOSSIBLE LATERthe history never gets writtenRecord the revision behind each runprimitives commit + model + what loadedA named owner per primitiveone line in CODEOWNERSSplit inherited from localone directory decision, while it’s small→ week oneEXPENSIVE NOW · CHEAP TO ADD LATERa gate protects every change from its first dayBehavioral review gatesbefore / after on recorded tasksRegression task setsbuilt, then maintained as code movesCleanup sweepsany quarter — the owner is the early part→ later, where blast radius justifies itThe expensive practices cost the same whenever you start. The boring ones are only cheap once.
